PIMPMYPONY TXT2IMG — WILDCARDS + FACE DETAILER

PonyXL / Illustrious Text-to-Image with TagForge wildcards and built-in Easy-Use Face Detailer (no Impact Pack needed).

🖥️ Civitai Model

  • PimpMyPony - Real Anime
  • PimpMyPony - InCase Style
  • PimpMyPony - Semi Real Anime

The workflow ships with ilustmix_v111.safetensors — any Pony/Illustrious XL checkpoint works.

😊 FACE DETAILER (Easy-Use — no Impact Pack)

Runs on UltralyticsDetector → PreDetailerFix → DetailerFix from ComfyUI-Easy-Use.

Required detector models:

  • face_yolov8m.pt → ComfyUI/models/ultralytics/bbox/
    🔗 download
  • sam_vit_b_01ec64.pth → ComfyUI/models/sams/
    🔗 download

🎛️ AutoTag Node with Wildcards included

Install it from ComfyUI Manager or clone the repo:

cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes
git clone https://github.com/huchukato/ComfyUI-TagForge.git

✨ Wildcard Sub-Selection (a1111-sd-webui-tagcomplete style):

  • Type __ to see available wildcards
  • Select a wildcard with arrow keys and press Enter → inserts __wildcard_name__
  • Auto-show options → immediately displays all options from that wildcard
  • Select an option and press Enter → replaces wildcard with chosen option
  • ESC → keeps inserted wildcard and closes options

🌟 Features

  • Smart parsing: wildcards with complex paths (e.g. __pmp/blwjob/blwjb__)
  • Line-by-line options: each line in wildcard file becomes a separate option
  • Text overflow handling: long options truncated with hover expansion
  • Full compatibility with existing wildcard files and formats
  • Multiple sources: repository, ComfyUI/models and DynamicPrompts

📁 Wildcard Sources (in priority order):

  1. Repository wildcards/ folder
  2. ComfyUI models/wildcards/
  3. ComfyUI custom_nodes/wildcards/
  4. DynamicPrompts wildcards/
  5. Extra model paths configuration

This extension is based on ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts.

📁 Manual Wildcard Setup (Optional)

To use wildcards with Easy-Use you may need to copy the wildcards folder:

cp -r /path/to/ComfyUI-TagForge/wildcards \
    /path/to/ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-Easy-Use/wildcards/

Then restart ComfyUI to load the new wildcards.
